rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a short nasal sniff, including sniffing around to detect a smell.

example.english: This coffee smells so good that I can't help but sniff.
example.traditional: 呢杯咖啡咁香，我忍唔住索鼻。
example.jyutping: ne1 bui1 gaa3 fe1 gam3 hoeng1 ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 sok3 bei6

rows.jyutping: jat1 bin1 sok3 bei6 jat1 bin1 gong2
rows.note: Use this construction when someone says something while audibly sniffing because of illness, emotion, or contempt.

example.english: They said, while they sniff, “I’m fine.”
example.traditional: 佢一邊索鼻一邊講：「我冇事呀。」
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 bin1 sok3 bei6 jat1 bin1 gong2 ngo5 mou5 si6 aa3

rows.note: Use this in a drug-related context for snorting a powdered drug through the nose.

example.english: They sniff cocaine in the bathroom.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ci3 so2 sok3 baak6 fan2
